next.reason: 1985 refuses WRITE FROM when 'Record-name-1 and identifier-1 ... refer to the same storage area', and no other 1985 rule allows it. 2023 has no such syntax rule: §2023:14.9.51.4 GR5 NOTE 1 says the overlapping-operand and MOVE rules 'apply to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area associated with record-name-1 share any part of their storage areas', the WRITE being undefined only if the implicit MOVE is; §2023:14.9.51.4 GR9 contemplates identifier-1 being part of the file's record descriptions. A refused program is now accepted; no exception condition.
